transcript: Quick note to myself. I need to pay the electricity bill before Friday or there will be a late fee. Also, I promised my sister I'd send her the photos from last weekend. Don't forget to renew the gym membership, it expires on the 25th. Oh, and I need to call the dentist to reschedule my appointment.
ideal_summary: A personal reminder covering four time-sensitive tasks: paying the electricity bill before Friday, sending photos to a sister, renewing a gym membership before the 25th, and rescheduling a dentist appointment.
